metadata.name: GetTransactionAuthorizationStatus
metadata.description: This API is used to fetch the updated status of Outstanding Transaction Authorization and is only Applicable when MTA is enabled on Product and Merchant.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Condition: At least one of MerchantNumber/MerchantID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Specific ID Assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 562489 Condition: At least one of MerchantNumber/MerchantID is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholders. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one of AccountNumber/ApplicationNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ApplicationNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example: 8002201421 Condition::At least one of AccountNumber/ApplicationNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AuthTranID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number received from Post Single Transaction API. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: MerchantNumber
children.description: Merchant Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Merchant Name which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid: A-Z Format: XXXXXX Example: ABCD LLC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ApplicationNumber
children.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:8002201421 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number of the Approved/Matched Merchant Transaction Authorization. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AuthTranID
children.description: Transaction Number received from Post Single Transaction API. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AuthorizedSource
children.description: Indicator for Authorization source Valid Values: 0 - Email, 1 - SMS, 2 - CSR or 3 - Cancelled by Provider Example:0

children.name: AuthorizationStatus
children.description: Must return Authorization Status. Valid Values: Rejected = If Transaction Authorization is Rejected, Expired = If Transaction Authorization is Aged-Off, Decline = If Manual Auth from CC is Declined,Matched = If the Transaction Authorization is Accepted

children.name: TransactionPostTime
children.description: Time of Transaction Posted. Valid Values:12-30-2015T13:05:10 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss Example:12/30/2015 13:05:10

children.name: TransactionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time of transaction occurred. Valid Values:0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00

children.name: AuthorizationReceivedDate
children.description: Date and Time when Authorization is received from AuthUpdate API. Valid Values:0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00 Condition: Required when Authorization status is either Matched or Rejected

children.name: AuthAgedoffDate
children.description: Date and Time when transaction expired/aged off. Valid Values:0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00 Condition: Required when Authorization status is Expired.

children.name: RejectReason
children.description: Must display the Reject reason only for transaction type ‘Rejected’ and must be updated with the latest Response. Valid Values: Did Not Authorize, Services Not Yet Scheduled,Services Scheduled Beyond 30 Days, Wrong Amount, Wrong Plan or Cancelled by Provide Example: Wrong Plan Condition: Required when Authorization status is Rejected

children.name: DeclineReason
children.description: Specific reason for the decline of transaction posting. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example:abc123 Condition: Required when Authorization status is Decline.

children.name: AccountActivationStatus
children.description: Indicates Account Activation status Valid Values: Not Activated, Activated Example: Activated

children.name: ActivationDate
children.description: Indicates the date time of Account Activation. Valid Values: 0-2 Format: mmddyyyyhhmmss Example: 12-12-2020164632 Required when Account Activation Status is Activated.

children.name: ActivationSource
children.description: Indicator for Account Activation source Valid Values: “0”- Email, “1”- SMS, “2” –CSR Format: X Example: 0 Condition: Required when Account Activation Status is Activated.
